source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 6 (PDF 153-174), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 6 (Emerging Technologies) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.
6.1 Definition and Overview of Emerging Technologies

blocks.prompt:
1 New tools, systems and methods that are currently being developed or have just started to be used are called:
(Naye tools, systems aur tareeqe jo abhi ban rahe hain ya jin ka istemal abhi shuru hua hai, unhein kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.1: emerging technologies (ubharti hui technologies) woh naye tools, systems aur tareeqe hain jo abhi ban rahe hain ya jin ka istemal abhi shuru hua hai.

book_ref.quote: Emerging technologies are new tools, systems, and methods that are currently being developed

blocks.prompt:
2 Which two transformative technologies are the main subject of this chapter?
(Is chapter ka asal mauzoo kaun si do badal dene wali technologies hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.1 (Introduction): yeh chapter Cloud Computing aur Blockchain ko tafseel se dekhta hai.

book_ref.quote: This chapter explores two of the most transformative technologies of our time

blocks.prompt:
3 Machines and software that can think and learn like humans are known as:
(Woh machines aur software jo insanon ki tarah soch aur seekh sakte hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.1: AI se murad woh machines aur software hain jo insanon ki tarah soch aur seekh sakte hain, jaise chehre pehchanna aur bol samajhna.

book_ref.quote: AI refers to machines and software that can think and learn like humans

blocks.prompt:
4 Smart assistants like Siri and self-driving cars are examples of the use of:
(Siri jaise smart assistants aur khud chalne wali gaariyan kis technology ke istemal ki misalein hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.1: AI Siri jaise smart assistants se le kar khud chalne wali gaariyon tak har jagah istemal hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: It's used in everything from smart assistants like Siri to self-driving cars

blocks.prompt:
5 Google Drive, Dropbox and Amazon Web Services (AWS) are examples of:
(Google Drive, Dropbox aur Amazon Web Services (AWS) kis cheez ki misalein hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.1: cloud computing internet par data aur applications rakhne aur istemal karne deti hai; misalein Google Drive, Dropbox aur AWS hain.

book_ref.quote: Examples include services like Google Drive, Dropbox, and Amazon Web Services (AWS)

blocks.prompt:
6 The technology best known for being behind cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin is:
(Bitcoin jaisi cryptocurrencies ke peeche sab se mashhoor technology kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.1: blockchain Bitcoin jaisi cryptocurrencies ki technology ke taur par mashhoor hai; yeh supply chains aur contracts mein bhi istemal hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: It's best known for being the technology behind cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin

blocks.prompt:
7 A smart thermostat that learns your schedule and adjusts the temperature of your home automatically is an example of:
(Smart thermostat jo aap ka schedule seekh kar ghar ka temperature khud set karta hai, kis ki misal hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.1: IoT rozmarra ki cheezon ko internet se jorta hai taake woh data bhej aur le sakein; smart thermostat kitab ki misal hai.

book_ref.quote: a smart thermostat can learn your schedule and adjust the temperature

blocks.prompt:
8 Which technology adds digital elements to the real world using devices like smartphones or glasses?
(Kaun si technology smartphones ya glasses ke zariye asal duniya mein digital cheezein shamil karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.1: AR asal duniya mein digital cheezein jorti hai; VR is ke bajaye poora virtual mahol banati hai.

book_ref.quote: AR adds digital elements to the real world using devices like smartphones or glasses

blocks.prompt:
9 Virtual Reality (VR) differs from AR because VR:
(Virtual Reality (VR) AR se kis tarah mukhtalif hai?)

options.text: asal duniya mein digital cheezein jorti hai
khaas saman ke saath istemal hone wala mukammal virtual mahol banati hai
fridge aur gaariyon ko internet se jorti hai
zinda ajsam se cheezein banati hai

blocks.explanation: 6.1: VR aik mukammal virtual mahol banati hai jis se khaas saman ke zariye raabta kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: VR creates a completely virtual environment that you can interact with using special equipment

blocks.prompt:
10 5G is best described as:
(5G ki behtareen tareef kya hai?)

options.text: cloud deployment model ki aik qisam
wireless technology ki agli nasal, tez speed aur behtar connection ke saath

blocks.explanation: 6.1: 5G wireless technology ki agli nasal hai jo bohat tez internet aur zyada qabil-e-aitbar connection deti hai.

book_ref.quote: 5G is the next generation of wireless technology

blocks.prompt:
11 Quantum computers process information using the principles of:
(Quantum computers kin usoolon ki madad se information process karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.1: quantum computers quantum physics ke usoolon se information ko aam computers se bohat tez process karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Quantum computers use the principles of quantum physics to process information

blocks.prompt:
12 Using living organisms like bacteria and plants to create new products or solve problems is called:
(Bacteria aur plants jaise zinda ajsam se nayi cheezein banana ya masail hal karna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.1: biotechnology zinda ajsam se nayi dawaiyan, behtar faslein aur mahol dost materials banati hai.

book_ref.quote: Biotechnology involves using living organisms, like bacteria and plants

blocks.prompt:
13 Cloud computing gives access to computing resources like servers, storage and applications:
(Cloud computing servers, storage aur applications jaise resources tak rasai kaise deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2: cloud computing internet ke zariye computing resources tak aasan rasai deti hai.

book_ref.quote: allows easy and convenient access to computing resources like servers, storage, and applications over the internet

blocks.prompt:
14 In cloud computing, how does a user normally pay?
(Cloud computing mein user aam taur par kaise pay karta hai?)

options.text: provider ke hardware ki advance qeemat

blocks.explanation: 6.2: aap service ko zaroorat ke mutabiq kam ya zyada istemal karte hain aur sirf utna pay karte hain jitna istemal kiya.

book_ref.quote: you only pay for what you use

blocks.prompt:
15 The book compares cloud computing to:
(Kitab cloud computing ko kis cheez se tashbeeh deti hai?)

options.text: supercomputer kiraye par lena jo kahin se bhi kabhi bhi istemal ho

blocks.explanation: 6.2: cloud computing aisi hai jaise aik supercomputer kiraye par lena jo duniya mein kahin se bhi jab chahein istemal ho.

book_ref.quote: It's like renting a supercomputer that you can use whenever you need it

blocks.prompt:
16 The technology that lets a single physical machine run multiple virtual machines is:
(Woh technology jo aik physical machine par kai virtual machines chalane deti hai:)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.1.1: virtualization aik physical machine par kai virtual machines chalane deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Virtualization is a technology that allows a single physical machine to run multiple virtual machines

blocks.prompt:
17 With virtualization, each virtual computer inside a physical computer:
(Virtualization mein physical computer ke andar har virtual computer:)

options.text: doosron ke saath aik hi operating system share karta hai
apna operating system aur applications chala sakta hai
sirf aik application chala sakta hai
ko apni alag physical hard disk chahiye

blocks.explanation: 6.2.1.1: har virtual computer apna operating system aur applications aise chala sakta hai jaise alag machine ho.

book_ref.quote: Each of these virtual computers can run its own operating system and applications

blocks.prompt:
18 Which of the following is NOT a benefit of virtualization given in the book?
(In mein se kaun sa virtualization ka faida kitab mein NAHI diya gaya?)

options.text: Is ke liye zyada physical computers chahiye
Aasan management aur lachak deti hai

blocks.explanation: 6.2.1.1: virtualization hardware ka behtar istemal, kam kharch aur aasan management deti hai; yeh aik computer ko kai bana deti hai.

book_ref.quote: This helps make better use of the hardware, reduces costs

blocks.prompt:
19 During Eid sales an online store gets a huge spike in traffic and adds more servers. This is an example of:
(Eid sale mein online store par traffic achanak barh jata hai aur woh mazeed servers jor leta hai. Yeh kis ki misal hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.1.2: scalability (barhne ki salahiyat) ka matlab hai zaroorat par mazeed resources (jaise servers) jorna.

book_ref.quote: Scalability means you can add more resources when you need them

blocks.prompt:
20 Elasticity differs from scalability because in elasticity the system:
(Elasticity scalability se kis tarah mukhtalif hai? Elasticity mein system:)

options.text: demand ke mutabiq resources khud adjust karta hai
har tabdeeli ke liye manual setup chahta hai
sirf aik physical server par chalta hai

blocks.explanation: 6.2.1.2: elasticity scalability se aage hai: system mojooda demand ke mutabiq resources khud kam ya zyada karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Elasticity takes this a step further by allowing the system to automatically adjust

blocks.prompt:
21 In an elastic cloud system, what happens when the traffic decreases after a sale?
(Elastic cloud system mein sale ke baad traffic kam hone par kya hota hai?)

options.text: Servers kam ho jate hain taake faltu resources ka paisa na lage
Mazeed servers jor diye jate hain
Data local computer par chala jata hai

blocks.explanation: 6.2.1.2: traffic kam hone par system servers kam kar deta hai taake ghair zaroori resources ka paisa na dena pare.

book_ref.quote: When the traffic decreases after the sale, the system can reduce the number of servers

blocks.prompt:
22 Turning on a tap to get water instead of digging a well first is the book's analogy for:
(Kunwan khodne ke bajaye tap khol kar paani lena kitab mein kis ki tashbeeh hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.1.3: on-demand access ka matlab hai lambay setup ke baghair jab chahein resources istemal karna, jaise tap kholna.

book_ref.quote: This is like being able to turn on a tap to get water whenever you want

blocks.prompt:
23 A student suddenly needs extra storage for a school project and instantly rents it from a cloud provider. This shows:
(Student ko school project ke liye achanak extra storage chahiye aur woh foran cloud provider se kiraye par le leta hai. Yeh kya dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.1.3: on-demand access se aap foran cloud provider se extra storage kiraye par le kar istemal shuru kar sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: you can instantly rent additional storage from a cloud provider

blocks.prompt:
24 Into how many main types are cloud services typically categorized?
(Cloud services ko aam taur par kitni bari qismon mein baanta jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.2: cloud services aam taur par teen bari qismon mein hain: IaaS, PaaS aur SaaS.

book_ref.quote: Cloud services are typically categorized into three main types

blocks.prompt:
25 Basic computing infrastructure such as servers, storage and networking on a pay-as-you-go basis is offered by:
(Servers, storage aur networking jaisa bunyadi infrastructure pay-as-you-go par kaun deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.2.1: IaaS bunyadi infrastructure (servers, storage, networking) pay-as-you-go par deta hai.

book_ref.quote: IaaS offers basic computing infrastructure such as servers, storage, and networking

blocks.prompt:
26 In IaaS, users do NOT have control over:
(IaaS mein users ka kis cheez par control NAHI hota?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.2.1: IaaS mein users operating systems, applications aur storage control karte hain, lekin neeche wala physical infrastructure nahi.

book_ref.quote: Users have control over the operating systems, applications, and storage

blocks.prompt:
27 Renting virtual servers from AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Compute Engine to run your own applications is an example of:
(AWS, Microsoft Azure ya Google Compute Engine se apni applications chalane ke liye virtual servers kiraye par lena kis ki misal hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.2.1: AWS virtual servers kiraye par deta hai; Microsoft Azure aur Google Compute Engine bhi mashhoor IaaS providers hain.

book_ref.quote: Microsoft Azure and Google Compute Engine are other popular IaaS providers

blocks.prompt:
28 Besides infrastructure, PaaS includes:
(Infrastructure ke ilawa PaaS mein kya shamil hota hai?)

options.text: middleware, development tools aur management services

blocks.explanation: 6.2.2.2: PaaS mein infrastructure ke saath middleware, development tools aur management services hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: It includes infrastructure (servers, storage, and networking), middleware, development tools

blocks.prompt:
29 Google App Engine, Microsoft Azure App Services and Heroku are examples of:
(Google App Engine, Microsoft Azure App Services aur Heroku kis ki misalein hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.2.2: Google App Engine developers ko applications banane aur deploy karne deta hai; doosri PaaS misalein Azure App Services aur Heroku hain.

book_ref.quote: Other examples include Microsoft Azure App Services and Heroku

blocks.prompt:
30 In which service model do users simply subscribe and use software applications hosted and managed by the provider?
(Kis service model mein users sirf subscribe kar ke provider ki host aur manage ki hui software applications internet par istemal karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.2.3: SaaS provider ki host ki hui software applications deta hai; users subscribe kar ke internet par istemal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Users simply subscribe to the service and use it over the internet

blocks.prompt:
31 SaaS is convenient for end-users because it:
(SaaS end-users ke liye aasan kyun hai?)

options.text: physical servers ka poora control deta hai
user ko middleware install karna parta hai
hardware management ya software updates ki zaroorat nahi

blocks.explanation: 6.2.2.3: SaaS mein end-users ko hardware sambhalna ya software update karna nahi parta.

book_ref.quote: This model is convenient for end-users as it requires no hardware management or software updates

blocks.prompt:
32 Google Workspace, which includes Gmail, Google Docs and Google Drive, was formerly called:
(Google Workspace (jis mein Gmail, Google Docs aur Google Drive hain) pehle kis naam se tha?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.2.3: Google Workspace (pehle G Suite) SaaS ki misal hai jis mein Gmail, Google Docs aur Google Drive hain.

book_ref.quote: Example: Google Workspace (formerly G Suite)

blocks.prompt:
33 Salesforce, one of the leading SaaS providers, is known for its:
(Salesforce, jo aik bara SaaS provider hai, kis cheez ke liye mashhoor hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.2.3 (Did You Know?): Salesforce apne CRM platform ke liye mashhoor hai jo customer data, sales aur marketing sambhalta hai.

book_ref.quote: known for its customer relationship management (CRM) platform

blocks.prompt:
34 According to the book, Salesforce is used by over:
(Kitab ke mutabiq Salesforce kitni se zyada companies istemal karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.2.3 (Did You Know?): 150,000 se zyada companies Salesforce istemal karti hain.

book_ref.quote: Over 150,000 companies use Salesforce

blocks.prompt:
35 Cloud computing services are priced:
(Cloud computing services ki qeemat kaise lagti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.2.3 (Did You Know?): cloud services ki qeemat istemal ke mutabiq hai; pay-as-you-go model se business zaroorat ke mutabiq resources barhata ghatata hai.

book_ref.quote: Cloud computing services are priced based on usage

blocks.prompt:
36 What do cloud deployment models define?
(Cloud deployment models kya bayan karte hain?)

options.text: block pichhle block se kaise jurta hai
cloud services kaise muhayya aur istemal hoti hain
virtual machines kaise band hoti hain

blocks.explanation: 6.2.3: cloud deployment models batate hain ke cloud services kaise muhayya aur istemal hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Cloud deployment models define how cloud services are made available and used

blocks.prompt:
37 Which of the following is NOT one of the main cloud deployment models named in the book?
(In mein se kaun sa kitab ke bataye gaye bare cloud deployment models mein NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.3: bare deployment models Public, Private, Hybrid aur Multi-Cloud hain. Serverless aik architecture (6.6.1.2) hai, deployment model nahi.

book_ref.quote: The main cloud deployment models are Public, Private, Hybrid, and Multi-Cloud

blocks.prompt:
38 A public cloud is managed by:
(Public cloud ko kaun manage karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.3.1: public cloud internet par kai idaron mein share hota hai aur third-party cloud provider ise manage karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is managed by a third-party cloud service provider

blocks.prompt:
39 A private cloud can be hosted:
(Private cloud kahan host ho sakta hai?)

options.text: sirf third-party ke paas aur sab ke saath share
idare ke andar ya third-party ke paas, magar doosre idaron se share nahi
sirf users ke mobile phones par

blocks.explanation: 6.2.3.2: private cloud sirf aik idare ka hota hai; yeh idare ke andar ya third-party ke paas host ho sakta hai magar share nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: It can be hosted on-premises or by a third-party provider

blocks.prompt:
40 A large bank wants to handle sensitive customer data so that only the bank has access to it. The suitable model is:
(Aik bara bank hassas customer data aise rakhna chahta hai ke sirf bank ki rasai ho. Munasib model kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.3.2: bara bank hassas data ke liye private cloud istemal kar sakta hai; sirf bank ki rasai hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: A large bank may use a private cloud to handle sensitive customer data securely

blocks.prompt:
41 In a hybrid cloud, during busy periods a company moves which of these to the public cloud?
(Hybrid cloud mein masroof waqt mein company kya public cloud par muntaqil karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.3.3: masroof waqt mein kam hassas data aur applications public cloud par jati hain jab ke ahem data private cloud mein mehfooz rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: they can move less sensitive data and applications to the public cloud

blocks.prompt:
42 A main reason for using a multi-cloud approach is to:
(Multi-cloud approach istemal karne ki aik bari wajah kya hai?)

options.text: aik provider par inhisar (dependency) se bachna
sara data aik provider ke paas rakhna
kisi service ka paisa na dena

blocks.explanation: 6.2.3.4: multi-cloud mukhtalif providers ki services leta hai; is se aik provider par inhisar khatam hota hai aur reliability barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: This model helps avoid dependency on a single provider

blocks.prompt:
43 A company uses Google Cloud Platform for data analytics, Microsoft Azure for enterprise applications and AWS for backup. This is:
(Company data analytics ke liye Google Cloud Platform, enterprise applications ke liye Azure aur backup ke liye AWS istemal karti hai. Yeh kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.3.4: mukhtalif providers (GCP, Azure, AWS) ki services lena multi-cloud hai; aik provider mein masla ho to baqi kaam aate hain.

book_ref.quote: A company might use Google Cloud Platform for its data analytics

blocks.prompt:
44 Which deployment model is cost-effective but less secure?
(Kaun sa deployment model sasta hai magar kam mehfooz hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.4: public cloud sasta magar kam mehfooz hai; private cloud zyada mehfooz magar mehnga hai.

book_ref.quote: Public clouds are cost-effective but less secure

blocks.prompt:
45 According to the comparison of deployment models, resilience is provided by:
(Deployment models ke muqable ke mutabiq resilience (mushkil mein chalte rehna) kaun deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.2.4: hybrid cloud lachak deta hai jab ke multi-cloud resilience deta hai.

book_ref.quote: while multi-clouds provide resilience

blocks.prompt:
46 Which statement about private clouds is correct according to the book?
(Kitab ke mutabiq private cloud ke bare mein kaun sa bayan sahi hai?)

options.text: Hamesha kai providers istemal karte hain

blocks.explanation: 6.2.4: private cloud zyada mehfooz magar mehnga hai.

book_ref.quote: Private clouds are more secure but expensive

blocks.prompt:
47 Cloud storage lets users save their data on:
(Cloud storage users ko data kahan mehfooz karne deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.3.1.1: cloud storage data ko local devices ke bajaye door ke servers par rakhti hai, taake kahin se bhi mile aur share ho.

book_ref.quote: Cloud storage allows users to save data on remote servers rather than on local devices

blocks.prompt:
48 Businesses keep backups of their data in cloud storage mainly to keep it safe from:
(Business apne data ka backup cloud storage mein zyada tar kis cheez se bachane ke liye rakhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: 6.3.1.1: cloud backup data ko local hardware kharabi ya doosre masail se mehfooz rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: ensuring it is safe from local hardware failures

blocks.prompt:
49 Cloudflare is an example of a:
(Cloudflare kis cheez ki misal hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.3.1.2: Cloudflare jaise content delivery networks (CDNs) website ka content tez pohanchate hain.

book_ref.quote: Content delivery networks (CDNs) such as Cloudflare help deliver website content quickly

blocks.prompt:
50 A CDN delivers website content quickly by:
(CDN website ka content tez kaise pohanchata hai?)

options.text: sirf aik markazi server se bhej kar
content ko users ke qareeb servers par cache kar ke

blocks.explanation: 6.3.1.2: CDN content ko users ke qareeb servers par cache (aarzi mehfooz) kar ke tez pohanchata hai.

book_ref.quote: by caching it on servers close to the end-users

blocks.prompt:
51 Google Cloud AI and AWS SageMaker are cloud-based platforms for:
(Google Cloud AI aur AWS SageMaker kis kaam ke cloud platforms hain?)

options.text: machine learning models banana, train aur deploy karna

blocks.explanation: 6.3.1.3: Google Cloud AI aur AWS SageMaker machine learning models banane, train karne aur deploy karne ke cloud platforms hain.

book_ref.quote: Google Cloud AI and AWS SageMaker provide cloud-based platforms

blocks.prompt:
52 Storing sensitive data on remote servers introduces risks such as:
(Hassas data door ke servers par rakhne se kaun se khatre paida hote hain?)

options.text: data breach aur data ka zaya hona

blocks.explanation: 6.3.2.1: security bara masla hai; hassas data door ke servers par rakhne se data breach aur data ke zaya hone ka khatra hai.

book_ref.quote: Storing sensitive data on remote servers introduces risks such as data breaches and loss

blocks.prompt:
53 To mitigate security risks in the cloud, users should:
(Cloud mein security khatre kam karne ke liye users ko kya karna chahiye?)

options.text: encryption aur mazboot authentication, aur security policies ka baqaida jaiza

blocks.explanation: 6.3.2.1: users ko encryption, mazboot authentication istemal karni chahiye aur security policies baqaidagi se dekhni chahiyein.

book_ref.quote: users should use encryption, strong authentication methods

blocks.prompt:
54 Which practice is part of effective resource management in the cloud?
(Cloud mein achhi resource management mein kaun sa amal shamil hai?)

options.text: har waqt tamam servers on rakhna
resource ke istemal par nazar aur performance behtar karna

blocks.explanation: 6.3.2.2: resource ke istemal par nazar rakhna aur performance behtar karna kharch control karta hai.

book_ref.quote: such as monitoring resource usage and optimizing performance

blocks.prompt:
55 Why does cloud computing require careful financial management?
(Cloud computing mein ehtiyat se maali intizam kyun zaroori hai?)

options.text: Jitna istemal utna pay, aur nigrani na ho to kharch tezi se barhta hai
Zindagi mein sirf aik dafa pay karna hota hai

blocks.explanation: 6.3.2.3: users jitna istemal karein utna pay karte hain, aur nigrani na ho to kharch jaldi barh jata hai.

book_ref.quote: costs can quickly add up if not monitored

blocks.prompt:
56 Legal and regulatory requirements that cloud users must comply with:
(Woh qanooni aur regulatory taqaze jin ki cloud users ko pabandi karni hai:)

options.text: ilaqe aur industry ke mutabiq badal sakte hain
sirf gaming companies par lagte hain

blocks.explanation: 6.3.2.4: idaron ko qanooni aur regulatory taqazon ki pabandi karni hai jo ilaqe aur industry ke mutabiq badalte hain.

book_ref.quote: which can vary by region and industry

blocks.prompt:
57 Compliance in cloud computing means adhering to regulations related to:
(Cloud computing mein compliance ka matlab kin qawaneen ki pabandi hai?)

options.text: data privacy, security aur industry ke khaas standards

blocks.explanation: 6.3.2.4: idaron ko data privacy, security aur industry ke khaas standards ke qawaneen ki pabandi karni hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: regulations related to data privacy, security, and industry-specific standards

blocks.prompt:
58 Blockchain enables secure and transparent transactions through a:
(Blockchain mehfooz aur shaffaf transactions kis ke zariye mumkin banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.4: blockchain distributed ledger (taqseem shuda khata) system ke zariye mehfooz aur shaffaf transactions deta hai.

book_ref.quote: enables secure and transparent transactions through a distributed ledger system

blocks.prompt:
59 In the book's analogy, blockchain is like:
(Kitab ki tashbeeh mein blockchain kis ki tarah hai?)

options.text: aik kaghaz jo aik shakhs rakhe
digital notebook jis ki copy group ke har fard ke paas hai

blocks.explanation: 6.4.1: blockchain aik digital notebook ki tarah hai jis ki copy group ke har fard ke paas hai; har tabdeeli sab notebooks mein aik saath likhi jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Blockchain is like a digital notebook that's shared with everyone in a group

blocks.prompt:
60 In blockchain, information is locked in place by a special kind of math called:
(Blockchain mein information ko kis khaas math se apni jagah lock kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.4.1: likhi hui cheez ko mitana ya badalna taqreeban na-mumkin hai kyunke cryptography (khufia code ka ilm) use mehfooz rakhti hai.

book_ref.quote: protected by a special kind of math called cryptography

blocks.prompt:
61 In the shared-notebook picture of decentralization, changes are made only when:
(Decentralization ki notebook wali misal mein tabdeeli kab ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: 6.4.1: koi aik shakhs ya computer incharge nahi; tabdeeli tab hoti hai jab aksariyat razi ho.

book_ref.quote: changes are only made when the majority agree

blocks.prompt:
62 The feature of blockchain by which everyone can see what is recorded, making cheating hard, is:
(Blockchain ki woh khoobi jis se har koi record dekh sakta hai aur dhoka mushkil hota hai:)
